item.title: Version 2.0
item.description:
Sotto 2.0

First public release for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.

  • Redesigned native interface with a separate Dot near writing listener.
  • Local Whisper Turbo dictation and optional Parakeet and Cohere speech engines.
  • On-device cleanup, transcript history, App Modes, Vocabulary and Scratchpad.

No account, hosted inference, analytics or telemetry. The self-signed app is not notarized; Control-click and choose Open on first launch.
